messages:
elena_support: Customer reports 403 on the /v1/generate call saying 'invalid API key' after they upgraded workspace plan. They pasted curl and request-id: req_52b9f. Says it worked before upgrade.

marta: Got it — can you paste the exact curl + response headers? also workspace id and sku if they shared.

elena_support: Curl they ran: ```curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX' -d '{"model":"rw-large","input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate``` Response body: `{"error":{"message":"Invalid API key","type":"invalid_request_error"}}` Headers include `x-request-id: req_52b9f` and `x-rw-gate: entitlement`. Customer also shared org_id: org_7732 and sku: dev-plus-monthly.

support-bot: New ticket #INC-4821 created from thread (link internal).

samir_eng: I pulled the logs for req_52b9f — service returned 403 from entitlement check layer, internal code=ENTITLEMENT_DENIED, but gateway maps it to generic auth message. Log snippet: ```[2026-04-05T14:22:10Z] req=req_52b9f svc=auth-gate result=DENIED code=ENTITLEMENT_DENIED reason="missing sku entitlement:accelerated-gen"```

marta: ah — so it's not an API key issue, it's the plan missing that feature. Customer-facing error must not say 'Invalid API key' though. That's causing them to rotate keys.

elena_support: Customer already rotated keys which didn't help. They're frustrated and escalated to their CTO. Could we update the client error message ASAP and add a diagnostic header showing which entitlement failed?

eng-oncall: I'll add a short-term patch to the gateway mapping to preserve subcodes and return a clearer message: `{"error":{"message":"Access denied: feature 'accelerated-gen' not in plan","code":"ENTITLEMENT_DENIED"}}` and include `x-rw-entitlement-fail: accelerated-gen` header. Pushing change to canary now.

billing_lead: I checked org_7732 — they were partway through a plan migration and the dev-plus sku didn't include the accelerated-gen add-on. We can offer a one-time trial while we sort messaging. Please link billing contact to the ticket.

marta: Thanks — action items: 1) eng-oncall deploys mapping patch to canary (samir please review), 2) support follow up with customer and offer trial (elena), 3) billing to confirm upgrade flow (billing_lead). I'll update INC-4821 and ping @ctos if needed. :thumbsup:

samir_eng: review done, rolling to canary, will monitor errors and gate header. If we see other endpoints with same mapping we'll create a small RFC to standardize entitlement->HTTP mapping.

elena_support: Followed up with customer with the exact reason and temporary trial offer, they accepted. Closing loop once canary is green. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
